Dynamics Select Mode. Right-click for options

启用/禁用所有物体类型
Geometry Select Mode. Right-click for options
几何体选择模式。右键查看选项
几何体 UV 选择器
隐藏其他物体（局部空间）
隐藏其他物体（世界空间）
Object Select Mode. Right-click for options.
物体选择模式。右键查看选项。
选择所有匹配遮罩的物体
选择 n 边多边形
A scale factor applied to Animate state handles only. This is multiplied in with the standard 'Handle Scale' preference.
仅作用于 Animate 状态手柄的缩放系数，会与标准的「手柄缩放」首选项相乘。
A scale factor on the length of axes when placed inside the rotate sphere.
坐标轴放在旋转球内时的长度缩放系数。
A scale factor on the length of axes when placed outside the rotate sphere.
坐标轴放在旋转球外时的长度缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the arrow tips.
箭头尖端大小的缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the center box.
中心方块大小的缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the plane controls.
平面控制件大小的缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the rotate dots.
旋转点大小的缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the tumble sphere.
旋转球大小的缩放系数。
A scale factor on the size of the view rotate ring.
视图旋转环大小的缩放系数。
An offset on the position of the axes when placed inside the rotate sphere.
坐标轴放在旋转球内时的位置偏移。
An offset on the position of the axes when placed outside the rotate sphere.
坐标轴放在旋转球外时的位置偏移。
自动应用 APEX 手柄设置
Defines the default alignment for rotate components when separate alignments is enabled.
启用「分离对齐」时，旋转分量的默认对齐方式。
Defines the default alignment for scale components when separate alignements is enabled.
启用「分离对齐」时，缩放分量的默认对齐方式。
Defines the default alignment for translate components, or all components if Separate alignments is disabled.
平移分量的默认对齐方式；若未启用「分离对齐」，则应用于所有分量。
Indirect Drags Apply to Selected Component
间接拖动作用于所选分量
Place Axis Controls Outside Rotate Sphere
把坐标轴控制件放在旋转球外
Place Plane Controls Outside Rotate Sphere
把平面控制件放在旋转球外
Presets to apply to all of these settings.
应用到以上全部设置的预设。
Separate Alignments for Translate, Rotate, and Scale
平移、旋转、缩放分别使用独立对齐
在光标附近显示分量标签
Show Tumble Sphere in Combined Rotate and Translate Mode
旋转平移合并模式下显示旋转球
The brightness of the handle's drawables. A value of 0.0 will make the handle completely black. A value of 1.0 will give the maximum brightness.
手柄可绘制元素的亮度。0.0 会让手柄全黑，1.0 为最大亮度。
The clip distance of the rings. A value of 0.0 will clip the rings in in the center of the handle. A value of 1.0 will not clip the rings at all.
圆环的裁剪距离。0.0 会把圆环裁剪到手柄中心，1.0 则完全不裁剪。
The line width of the line drawables used to draw the axes and rings.
绘制坐标轴与圆环所用线条元素的线宽。
Use Alternate Rotate Mode for Rings by Default
圆环默认使用备用旋转模式
Use View Aligned Square as Center Control
用视图对齐方块作为中心控制件
Whether to change the center box to a view aligned square. This can be useful to see through the center of the handle.
是否把中心方块改为视图对齐的方形。这有助于看穿手柄中心。
Whether to enable the 'Change Mode Automatically' toggle when entering the state. When enabled, the handle will automatically change the transform mode when a new primary control is selected.
进入该状态时是否启用「自动切换模式」。启用后，选中新的主控制件时手柄会自动切换变换模式。
Whether to enable the 'Separate Alignments' toggle by default when entering the state.
进入该状态时是否默认启用「分离对齐」。
Whether to make the tumble sphere fully hidden with only the border visible when not hovered.
未悬停时是否把旋转球完全隐藏、只留边界。
Whether to move the translate axes outside of the rotate sphere in the combined rotate and translate mode.
旋转平移合并模式下，是否把平移坐标轴移到旋转球外。
Whether to move the translate plane controls outside of the rotate sphere in the combined rotate and translate mode.
旋转平移合并模式下，是否把平移平面控制件移到旋转球外。
Whether to open the value ladder for the component of the handle when middle mouse dragging.
中键拖动时是否为手柄对应分量打开数值梯。
Whether to refresh the handle interactively while changing preferences on this page.
在本页修改首选项时，是否实时刷新手柄。
Whether to select the last interacted component of the handle and apply indirect drags, right click actions and hotkeys to this component.
是否选中手柄上最后操作过的分量，并让间接拖动、右键操作和快捷键都作用于该分量。
Whether to show a label near the cursor showing the located part of the handle.
是否在光标附近显示标签，标明手柄上定位到的部位。
Whether to show handles in all open viewports. Turning this off may help with performance.
是否在所有已打开的视口中显示手柄。关闭可能有助于性能。
Whether to show the red rotate dots.
是否显示红色的旋转点。

Whether to show the tumble sphere in the combined rotate and translate mode. This depends on whether the tumble sphere is visible, as set by the 'Allow Dragging of Rotate Handles Between Rings' preference.
旋转平移合并模式下是否显示旋转球。这取决于「允许在圆环之间拖动旋转手柄」首选项里旋转球是否可见。
Accept changes to these type properties.
接受对这些类型属性的修改。
Can't edit handles for this operator.
无法编辑此节点的手柄。
Can't edit inputs/outputs for this operator.
无法编辑此节点的输入/输出。
从 VEX 代码获取属性
NOTE: Using #pragma for help text. Please, turn off "Get properties from vex code" in the Basic tab to enable the text editor below.
注意：帮助文本用的是 #pragma。请在「基础」标签页里关闭「从 VEX 代码获取属性」，以启用下方的文本编辑器。
